title: Answer: what is measurement or observation

statements.text: Physical existence is assessed operationally, by observing and manipulating units, as judged by a conscious observer. In the brain this becomes perturb and measure: stimulate cortex and record how the effect spreads and differentiates.

sources.quote: something can be said to exist physically if it can “take and make a difference”—bear a cause and produce an effect—as judged by a conscious observer/manipulator.
